# Nismara Group

> The overarching corporate website for Nismara virtual entities.
> Website korporat utama untuk entitas virtual Nismara.

[English]
Nismara Group is a virtual company group dedicated to simulation gaming. It oversees various virtual divisions across different simulation platforms and genres.

[Bahasa Indonesia]
Nismara Group adalah grup perusahaan virtual yang berdedikasi pada permainan simulasi (simulation gaming). Grup ini menaungi berbagai divisi virtual di berbagai platform dan genre simulasi.

## Divisions / Divisi

- **Nismara Transport**: Logistics and passenger division / Divisi logistik dan penumpang. [Website](https://transport.nismara.web.id)
- **Nismara Airlines**: Aviation division / Divisi penerbangan.
- **Nismara Racing**: Racing division / Divisi balapan. [Website](https://racing.nismara.web.id)
- **Nismara World**: Gaming subdivisions including / Subdivisi permainan meliputi:
  - Rice Kencur (Minecraft)
  - BLCK (GTA V / Action)
  - Nismara Farm (Farming Simulator)

## Content Structure / Struktur Konten

- `/` (Home): Overview of Nismara Group and its services. / Ringkasan tentang Nismara Group dan layanan yang diberikan.
- `/about-us`: Information about the company history and vision. / Informasi tentang sejarah dan visi perusahaan.
- `/articles`: Latest publications, news, and press releases. / Publikasi terbaru, berita, dan siaran pers.
- `/contact`: Contact information and inquiry forms. / Informasi kontak dan formulir pertanyaan.
- `/faq`: Frequently asked questions. / Pertanyaan yang sering diajukan.
- `/radio`: Nismara Radio station. / Stasiun radio Nismara.
